manual.en: Extract CMake.app/Contents/bin to an isolated tools root; select cmake explicitly.
manual.ru: Распакуйте CMake.app/Contents/bin в отдельный каталог инструментов; задайте абсолютный путь cmake в tools.json.

manual.en: Extract ninja and select it explicitly.
manual.ru: Распакуйте точную версию ninja; задайте абсолютный путь в tools.json.

manual.en: Use Qt 6.11.1 macOS arm64 including qtbase, qtdeclarative, qtmultimedia, qttools, qtshadertools and qtimageformats; select qt_root and macdeployqt.
manual.ru: Подготовьте Qt6.11.1 для macOS arm64 с qtbase, qtdeclarative, qtmultimedia, qttools, qtshadertools и qtimageformats; задайте qt_root и macdeployqt.

manual.en: Use Apple Installer only after authorization; alternatively provide an independently verified isolated GStreamer prefix.
manual.ru: Установите точный пакет через Apple Installer после авторизации либо предоставьте проверенный отдельный каталог GStreamer.

manual.en: Install the matching development package with runtime; select gstreamer_root.
manual.ru: Установите соответствующий пакет разработки вместе с runtime; задайте gstreamer_root.

manual.en: Python 3.13.0 matches the current test host only; obtain a reviewed security-maintained Python before production. Select an explicit interpreter.
manual.ru: Python3.13.0 соответствует текущей тестовой машине; для рабочего распространения нужна проверенная поддерживаемая версия с исправлениями безопасности. Задайте интерпретатор явно.

manual.en: Build with the repository approved disable-autodetect LGPL profile and h264_videotoolbox; include exact source archive/configuration/notices.
manual.ru: Соберите точную версию с утверждённым LGPL-профилем disable-autodetect и h264_videotoolbox; сохраните исходный архив, конфигурацию и лицензии.

manual_requirements.note: Apple authenticated download/installation requires the operator; never invoke xcode-select --install during assessment. Select DEVELOPER_DIR explicitly.
Supplied by the authorized selected Apple toolchain. /usr/bin/git must not be invoked until toolchain existence is established.
Manual verified tool input only; automatic source provenance for this version is not yet pinned.

notes: Publisher HTTPS SHA256 metadata pins downloads; mismatches are never overridable. No installer is silently executed.
Qt source catalog entry is pinned; automated Qt source provisioning is not implemented.
Historical installed test dependencies must have separately recorded receipt/provenance, accepted finding and exact version. They do not establish clean-machine production acceptance.
Python3.13.0 is historical, not security-maintained: production blocked until catalog updates and validation.
GStreamer1.28.6 present on test host is outside this catalog1.26.11; explicit reviewed local receipt required.
